trap.label: particípio
trap.wrong: Students that wish to enrol must apply and enrolment is limit to 30.
trap.right: Students wishing to enrol must apply; enrolment is limited to 30.
trap.why: Português usa “alunos que desejam”; em avisos formais prefere-se o particípio presente, e a restrição leva limited to.

mcq.q: How do you state a cap in a notice?

opts: Students wishing to enrol must apply.

fix.wrong: Students who wishing to enrol apply.

rewrite.prompt: Reduza: “Students who wish to enrol must apply.”
rewrite.answer: Students wishing to enrol must apply.

rewrite.prompt: Negativo: “Students wishing to enrol must apply.”
rewrite.answer: Students wishing to enrol need not apply.
